proposal.openalex_search: (pericarditis OR "pericardial inflammation") AND (colchicine OR colchicin OR Colcrys OR Mitigare OR Colgout OR Lodoco) AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines the condition, colchicine spelling and brand variants, and randomized-trial terms. Recurrence, adult age, background therapy, and blinding remain screening criteria to preserve sensitivity. No outcome, date, language, or specific-trial restrictions are applied.

proposal.openalex_search: ("heart failure" OR "cardiac failure" OR HFrEF OR "left ventricular systolic dysfunction") AND ((iron AND (intravenous OR parenteral OR infusion)) OR "ferric carboxymaltose" OR Ferinject OR Injectafer OR "ferric derisomaltose" OR "iron isomaltoside" OR Monofer OR Monoferric OR "iron sucrose" OR Venofer OR "ferric gluconate" OR Ferrlecit OR "iron dextran" OR CosmoFer OR INFeD OR ferumoxytol OR Feraheme OR Rienso OR "iron polymaltose") AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines heart-failure terminology, intravenous iron formulations and brands, and randomized-trial terms. Reduced ejection fraction and iron deficiency remain screening criteria to avoid missing studies whose titles or abstracts omit those qualifiers. No outcome, date, language, or specific-trial restrictions.

proposal.openalex_search: (insomnia OR sleeplessness OR "difficulty sleeping" OR "difficulty falling asleep") AND (melatonin OR "N-acetyl-5-methoxytryptamine" OR Circadin OR Slenyto OR Melaxen) AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines insomnia and insomnia-symptom terms with melatonin synonyms and brands, plus randomized-trial terms. Adult eligibility and double-blind placebo-controlled design are assessed during screening. No outcome, date, language, or specific-trial restrictions are applied.

proposal.openalex_search: ("heart failure" OR "cardiac failure" OR HFrEF OR "left ventricular systolic dysfunction") AND (sacubitril OR "sacubitril/valsartan" OR LCZ696 OR "LCZ-696" OR "LCZ 696" OR Entresto OR Neparvis OR ARNI OR "angiotensin-neprilysin inhibition" OR "angiotensin neprilysin inhibition" OR "angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitor" OR "angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor") AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines heart-failure terminology, intervention synonyms and brands, and randomised-trial terms. Broad heart-failure terms retain reports that omit reduced ejection fraction from titles and abstracts. Adult HFrEF, comparator, and double-blind active-controlled eligibility can be assessed during screening. No outcome, date, language, or specific-trial restrictions.

proposal.openalex_search: (obesity OR obese OR overweight OR "over weight" OR "excess weight") AND (semaglutide OR Wegovy OR Ozempic OR Rybelsus OR NN9535 OR "NN-9535" OR "NN 9535") AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines overweight/obesity, semaglutide names, and randomized-trial terms. No outcome, date, language, or specific-trial restrictions.

proposal.openalex_search: (diabetes OR diabetic OR T2D OR T2DM OR cardiovascular OR atherosclerosis OR "coronary artery disease") AND (SGLT2 OR "SGLT-2" OR "sodium glucose cotransporter 2" OR "sodium-glucose cotransporter-2" OR "sodium glucose co-transporter 2" OR "sodium-glucose co-transporter-2" OR "sodium glucose linked transporter 2" OR empagliflozin OR Jardiance OR canagliflozin OR Invokana OR dapagliflozin OR Farxiga OR Forxiga OR ertugliflozin OR Steglatro OR sotagliflozin OR Inpefa OR Zynquista OR bexagliflozin OR Brenzavvy OR ipragliflozin OR luseogliflozin OR tofogliflozin OR remogliflozin) AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines diabetes or cardiovascular populations with SGLT2 terminology, drug and brand names, and a sensitive randomized-trial concept. No outcome, date, language, or named-trial restrictions. Heart-failure-entry and kidney-outcome-entry exclusions are left to screening to avoid excluding eligible mixed populations.

proposal.openalex_search: (older OR elderly OR aged OR aging OR ageing OR geriatric OR septuagenarian OR octogenarian OR nonagenarian OR "primary prevention" OR "without cardiovascular disease" OR "without coronary heart disease") AND (statin OR "HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor" OR "HMG CoA reductase inhibitor" OR "hydroxymethylglutaryl coenzyme A reductase inhibitor" OR atorvastatin OR rosuvastatin OR pravastatin OR simvastatin OR lovastatin OR fluvastatin OR pitavastatin OR cerivastatin OR Lipitor OR Crestor OR Pravachol OR Zocor OR Mevacor OR Altoprev OR Lescol OR Livalo OR Livazo OR Baycol OR Lipobay) AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines older-age or primary-prevention population terms with statin class, generic and brand names, and randomized-trial terms. Broad population alternatives retain mixed-age trials with eligible older-adult subgroups. Exact age and absence of established cardiovascular disease require screening, particularly because the supplied age thresholds differ. No outcome, date, language or specific-trial restrictions are applied.

proposal.openalex_search: ((postpartum OR "post-partum" OR "post partum" OR postnatal OR "after childbirth" OR "after delivery") AND (haemorrhage OR hemorrhage OR bleeding) OR PPH) AND ("tranexamic acid" OR TXA OR Cyklokapron OR Cyclokapron OR Lysteda OR Transamin) AND (randomized OR randomised OR randomly OR randomization OR randomisation OR placebo OR trial)
proposal.rationale: Combines postpartum haemorrhage terminology, tranexamic acid and brand names, and randomized-trial terms without outcome, date, language, or named-trial restrictions.
